course.title: Manufacturing Process - II
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: The Taylorian tool life equation for machining C-40 steel with 18-4-1 H.S.S at a 13 feed of 0.2 mm/min and a depth of cut of 2 mm is given by VTⁿ = C where n and C are constants depending on the cutting conditions and tool work combinations. The following V and T observations have been noted: Cutting speed (v m/min): 25 36 Tool life (T min): 88 20
Calculate the index n and constant c. Hence recommended the cutting speed for a desired tool life of 65 minutes.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
